privacySubtitle: Before we scan, here's how DealLens AI handles your data.
privacyPoint1: Your images and analyses are stored securely and linked only to your account.
privacyPoint2: Images are sent to OpenAI GPT-4o for AI analysis. No image is used to train models.
privacyPoint3: Data is stored on our secure servers so you can access your scan history anywhere.
privacyPoint4: You can delete any scan or your entire account at any time from Profile.
privacyPoint5: We never sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing.
